summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13) into a temporary directory and then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a sibling 727KB file. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (custom string-array rotator `WV8StW`, character decoder `hc1jfK9` over a 1000+-entry constant table `n7gIxM`, hex-named globals, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is executed under the freshly downloaded non-Node runtime at install time, meaning Node-based install-time inspection tooling does not see the payload's runtime behavior. The package presents itself as a slate/React text-editor fork but ships no functionality justifying an alternate-runtime blob. The package is published under the @ornikar org scope while `repository` points to git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git — a scope/repository mismatch consistent with scope-squatting @ornikar-using installers. Installing the package causes arbitrary code from the obfuscated payload to execute on the installer's machine under a runtime fetched at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
